sources.title: GitHub - SeiKasahara/krea2-webui: fp8 version of krea2 model
sources.snippet: Community fork. This repository adds an fp8 + phased-offload runtime and a self-contained Web UI so Krea 2 runs locally on a single 16 GB consumer GPU. It is built on top of Krea AI's official Krea 2 inference code — all model credit belongs to Krea AI. The original project documentation is preserved below the fork notes.

sources.title: Krea2_FP8: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Krea2_FP8 is a weight-only quantized version of the Krea 2 OSS Turbo text-to-image transformer created by AlperKTS. The original model was built by KREA.ai and compressed from 24.76 GiB (BF16) to 12.01 GiB using selective FP8 (float8_e4m3fn) quantization, reducing memory requirements by approximately 51.5% while preserving output quality.
